summary: Stardust Power Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $5 million in common stock through agent B. Riley Securities. The stock trades on Nasdaq under SDST; last price $2.49 on May 6, 2026. No specific terms beyond commission rates (up to 3% agency, up to 5% principal). The filing is a routine shelf takedown (ATM), not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisor named. Proceeds for general corporate purposes. No regulatory clock or risk-arb angle. This is an ordinary capital-raising transaction under an existing shelf registration.
